description: This file is a shell script used for testing various aspects of Git operations, including cloning repositories with references, alternates, symlinks, and garbage objects. It defines helper functions and a series of test cases to verify Git's behavior under different scenarios.

methods.name: commit_in
methods.description: Creates a commit in the specified repository with the given filename and content.

methods.name: test_objcount
methods.description: Checks the number of loose objects in a repository against an expected count.
